Swept dark-brown top hair, the broad gray viewer-right temple/side and short sideburns are retained. The dark spectacles are round rather than the rejected heavy rectangular frames. The dark navy suit, white pointed shirt collar and purple tie with a small light pattern remain recognizable, with no added decorations. The slight viewer-left three-quarter pose and gaze, soft frontal-left light, tight crop and right-side note occlusion remain. The rounded chin meets the collar through a short broad fitted transition without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The complete blue-gray photographic backplate and thin frame remain. The cream note retains its two compact upper mark rows, blank lower paper and a small compact dark right-edge tab. Full white/cyan/alpha comparisons show no visible interior hole, lost backing or working-matte halo.
